Domain: Engineering · Unit: Second Law of Thermodynamics & Carnot Cycle · Topic: Reversible Carnot Heat Engine T-S Diagram

A reversible heat engine operates on the Carnot cycle shown on the temperature-entropy (T-S) diagram between TH=900 K and TL=300 K. If heat absorbed during isothermal expansion 2–3 is Qin=240 kJ, find the net work output enclosed by the cycle.

A
79.99 kJ
B
204.01 kJ
C
160.01 kJ
✓ Correct
D
60.0 kJ
View Explanation & Provenance (Answer: Option C)

Thermal efficiency from the T-S rectangle is η=1-300900=0.6667. Net work output equals the rectangular enclosed cycle area Wnet=η·Qin=160.01 kJ (whereas Option A represents heat rejected Q_out to the low-temperature sink).
